g.text: First comes the output from Basics.v itself.
Then each required exercise reports its point value,
whether its type is ok, and the assumptions it relies on.
A type that is not ok usually means the statement changed:
you proved the wrong thing and receive no points.
“Closed under the global context” means no unproved
theorems are needed: the exercise is solved.
A list of axioms means the work is not fully proved,
If the exercise’s own name is listed, it is still unproved,
